# GivingBridge Consulting

> GivingBridge Consulting is a fractional fundraising consultancy for nonprofits, founded and run by Nelvin Johnson. It helps small nonprofit teams, executive directors, and boards build the fundraising infrastructure, clarity, and roadmap to turn goodwill into lasting support. Tagline: "Fundraising that outlives the moment."

Legal entity: Giving Bridge Consulting LLC (New York). The Health Check and Donor Strategy Sprint are delivered fully remotely, for nonprofits anywhere in the U.S.

## Who it's for
- Executive directors who do development work on top of everything else
- Development teams of one to three people
- Boards that want to help with fundraising but lack structure
- Organizations that can't yet justify a full-time development director

## Services
- [Fractional Development](https://givingbridgeconsulting.com/#fractional): ongoing, part-time senior fundraising leadership without a full-time hire. Covers strategy across individual, mid-level, and major gifts, executable plans, and systems that prevent staff burnout. The flagship service.
- [Associate Board Development](https://givingbridgeconsulting.com/#associate-boards): build or restructure an associate board, with clear purpose, expectations, and term structure; recruitment for influence, generosity, and commitment; and members equipped to fundraise.
- [Donor Strategy](https://givingbridgeconsulting.com/#donor-strategy): project-based donor segmentation, donor journeys for key relationships, and an engagement cadence sized to the team's real capacity.

## Fixed-price offers
- [Fundraising Health Check](https://givingbridgeconsulting.com/health-check/), $79: a written diagnosis of a nonprofit's fundraising across four areas (donor retention, pipeline, board, and communications rhythm). The buyer completes a 15-minute questionnaire and receives a personalized PDF report within 48 hours: strongest area, weakest link, and the three changes to make first. No sales call required.
- [Donor Strategy Sprint](https://givingbridgeconsulting.com/sprint/), $1,200 flat, 3 weeks: four fixed deliverables (donor segmentation, a donor journey map, a 90-day engagement calendar, and a live working session with the team). It starts with a free scoping call, and the invoice follows.

## How engagements start
1. A free 15-minute conversation ([book here](https://calendar.app.google/1Do2GPcDJhYSkQES9))
2. Discovery and assessment
3. A roadmap matched to the right service

## About Nelvin Johnson
Founder of GivingBridge Consulting. He moved from the for-profit world into nonprofit fundraising and has spent six years in the field, most of it as a major gifts fundraiser at organizations with budgets from $700,000 to $450 million. He holds an M.S. in Nonprofit Management. His approach is relational and intentional, and clients work with him directly.

## Common questions
- **What is a fractional development director?** A fractional development director is a senior fundraising leader who works with your organization part-time. They set priorities, guide strategy across individual, mid-level, and major gifts, and build the systems your team needs, without the cost of a full-time hire. It's built for organizations that need senior fundraising leadership but can't yet justify a full-time development director.
- **How is fractional development different from a one-time consulting project?** Fractional development is an ongoing partnership: I work alongside your team week to week and adjust as your organization grows. A project, like the Donor Strategy Sprint, has a fixed scope, a fixed price, and a clear end date. Many organizations start with a project and move to fractional support later.
- **What is an associate board, and how is it different from a board of directors?** A board of directors governs the organization and carries legal and fiduciary responsibility. An associate board is a separate group of committed supporters, often emerging leaders, who raise money, advocate, and expand your network without governance duties. A well-designed associate board can also become a pipeline for future board members and major donors.
- **How much does it cost to work with GivingBridge?** There are two fixed-price ways to start: the Fundraising Health Check for $79, and the Donor Strategy Sprint for $1,200 flat. Fractional Development and Associate Board Development are scoped to your organization's needs, and we work out the details on a free 15-minute call.
- **What size organizations do you work with?** Mostly small nonprofits where fundraising rests on a few people: an executive director doing development on the side, a development team of one to three, or a board that wants to help. My own fundraising experience spans organizations with budgets from $700,000 to $450 million.
- **Do you work with nonprofits outside of New York?** Yes. The Health Check and the Donor Strategy Sprint are done entirely remotely, so your location doesn't matter. For ongoing work, we'll talk through what makes sense on the first call.
- **Do you write grants or plan events?** No. My focus is fundraising strategy and the systems behind it: donor relationships, board fundraising, and a steady rhythm of engagement. Those are what make grants, events, and campaigns more effective.
- **How do I get started?** Book a free 15-minute call, or start with the $79 Fundraising Health Check if you'd like a written diagnosis first, with no call required.
